gameDescriptionHtml:
Drill and Delve is a mining game in which you must unravel a mystery by exploring your surroundings.

FULLY DIGGABLE 3D VOXEL OPEN WORLD – Venture through a unique world made of a fully destructible terrain. Dig in every possible direction thanks to the 3D voxel technology.
EXPLORATION AND MYSTERY – You’re a miner in the far future who works for a mega-mining corporation. Today was supposed to be just another day at work, but when things go wrong deep underground, you find yourself trapped in a vast crumbling mine. In order to survive and unravel the mystery of what happened, you’ll have to dig your way out.
UPGRADE YOUR TOOLS – Discover new tools that will enable you to dig deeper, further and more efficiently. Manage your resources carefully and use physics to your advantage to find the rarest and most secret incredibly powerful tools as you delve your own path to freedom.

Game Features

  • Fully Diggable 3D Voxel Terrain. Dig through the world in any direction.
  • Physics-Based Interactions.
  • Loot better tools and equipment.
  • Manage your resources to survive.
  • Explore and uncover the mystery.
